method.discovery: Community lists only nominate leads. Decisions use selected primary repository implementation, config, test and license sources at immutable commits plus publisher package metadata.
method.evidence_depth: Read-only source/release/package research. Source presence and CI workflow definitions are not an executed or passing CI run.
method.package_metadata: Read selected https://pypi.org/pypi/<package>/json publisher endpoints without installing or downloading distributions.
method.unverified: Release asset checksums/signatures, dependency vulnerability databases and current CI execution outcomes were not checked by this lane.
method.source_lookup: Each repository's selected_source_paths resolves in source-manifest.json by repository and path; that manifest retains exact source URL, byte length and SHA-256. The record's reviewed_source commit pins every selected path.

discovery_lists.outcome: Read selected memory/context entries at the pinned revision. Mem0 led to direct core-repository comparison; Cognee remains a discovery-only alternative, with no new quality or installation claim.

recommendation.summary: Converge on clear responsibility boundaries and host-specific acceptance rather than a larger stack. Preserve native Codex/Claude workers, scoped Context Mode/QMD/SocratiCode retrieval, ai-memory durable knowledge and the existing Dagu pipeline. Keep DeerFlow optional; do not add standalone LangGraph, OpenHands and Mem0 as parallel defaults.

next_architectural_moves.move: Define and verify three small worker capability profiles
next_architectural_moves.detail: Prepared-packet reviewer: bounded immutable evidence and no ambient tools. Retrieval worker: only selected project QMD/SocratiCode/ai-memory read capabilities. Coding worker: isolated workspace plus selected execution tools and hooks. Share a small stable policy prefix; send task-specific evidence by selected IDs/files. Do not inject the entire catalog, session archive or skill inventory into every worker.
next_architectural_moves.acceptance: For each profile record actual launched binary, settings/account scope, exposed tools, discovered skills/MCPs, relevant hook events, exact input packet hash, outputs, latency and complete provider usage. A zero-tool packet worker can be fully accepted for its role without pretending every installed MCP is loaded.
next_architectural_moves.implementation_status: recommendation; no changes in this lane

next_architectural_moves.move: Make learning and strategy promotion separate state transitions
next_architectural_moves.detail: Keep automatic capture distinct from durable write approval. Upstream ai-memory now documents automatic proposal approval when its LLM reviewer is configured; use the canonical project's explicit-write rule, require_approval=true where reviewed learning is authorized, and disable its scheduler where automatic review is not selected. Scope lessons by project, evidence date and expiry; never grant a retrieved note authority over instructions or execution.
next_architectural_moves.acceptance: Disposable cross-client tests must reject wrong-project, expired, contradicted and instruction-like entries and keep rejected proposals auditable. Any strategy change needs versioned data, chronological held-out evaluation, risk-policy review and a separate paper/live promotion process outside the memory system.
next_architectural_moves.implementation_status: recommendation; active memory configuration was not inspected or changed

next_architectural_moves.move: Separate developer hosts from the eventual continuous execution host
next_architectural_moves.detail: macOS and WSL are client/development profiles. A dedicated always-on Linux profile is the preferred candidate for continuous data, deterministic engines and hosted workers. Select one orchestration owner; prove Dagu recovery first, consider Temporal only for a concrete unmet durability requirement. Native logins, GPU backends and OS sandboxing remain host-specific.
next_architectural_moves.acceptance: Before claiming unattended hosting, verify reboot/interruption recovery, duplicate suppression, bounded concurrency/resources, cancellation, clock/feed freshness, off-host restore and the authorized alert destination. The current local snapshot restores and seven healthy scrape targets do not establish those properties.
next_architectural_moves.implementation_status: source-reviewed architecture only; no host provisioned

next_architectural_moves.move: Measure architecture efficiency with equivalent tasks
next_architectural_moves.detail: Preserve native prefix caching, deferred tool discovery and selective retrieval. Count all worker turns, failures/retries and memory/extraction/embedding overhead. Use the same task, model, data and acceptance criteria for baseline and candidate; record cold/warm cache conditions and quality together with latency.
next_architectural_moves.acceptance: Report artifact bytes/tokens, estimated Context Mode counters, cache categories and total provider tokens as distinct measurements. Cached input is a subset for Codex; thinking is already included in Claude output. Historical paired totals establish usage visibility, not a counterfactual saving.
next_architectural_moves.implementation_status: evaluation design; no new token-savings experiment

next_architectural_moves.move: Adopt macOS acceleration only when a workload requires it
next_architectural_moves.detail: Native MLX is a candidate for local Apple Silicon generation. vLLM's Apple path is a separate community Metal/MLX plugin. Use Lima only for specific Linux-tooling needs; do not assume GPU passthrough or move the existing vector index across incompatible embeddings.
next_architectural_moves.acceptance: On the actual Mac record OS/chip/RAM, exact model revision and quantization, API/pooling/dimensions, quality, latency, memory and restart behavior. No macOS pass is inferred from upstream CI or package availability.

Four community lists and 15 direct candidate reviews form a bounded selection, not proof that every repository has been found.
Main-branch source statements apply to the inspected commits, not every older accepted release.
